label: 📅 Fiscal year parts
description: Decompose a date into fiscal-year, fiscal-quarter, and fiscal-month for any fiscal-year start month. Common values: 1 (calendar year), 4 (UK government), 7 (Australia), 10 (US federal). Output columns: fy_year, fy_quarter (1-4), fy_month (1-12).

fy_start_month.label: Fiscal year starts in month
fy_start_month.help: 1 = calendar; 4 = UK gov; 7 = Australia; 10 = US federal.
